name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Performance Strategy & Account Optimization | Paid Media, Experimentation & AI-Driven Analysis
summary: Performance and account strategist with 15+ years across MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments, including agency-side paid media strategy (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads certified), A/B-tested campaign builds, and performance reporting through weekly reviews and QBRs. Diagnoses where a funnel is actually breaking, from lead quality to on-site conversion, and turns the finding into a test or a fix. Builds AI-assisted analysis and evaluation frameworks that speed up diagnostics and keep outputs explainable to clients. A decade owning B2B accounts, including ~94% partner retention at Birdeye, means performance work stays tied to adoption and revenue.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Built AI-driven agent logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates personalized outreach, run through an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses.
Design self-improving loops and rubric-based evaluation frameworks to monitor AI-generated outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates, keeping results accurate and explainable to clients.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, using GA4, GTM, and CRM analytics.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable recommendations, translating non-technical owners' goals into structured tests and system changes.
Architected 20+ marketing-automation workflows (capture, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, nurture, reactivation) that turn optimization findings into repeatable playbooks.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated digital strategy across paid media, inbound, and content for client accounts, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Designed and ran LinkedIn ad campaigns using an account-based approach, targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups.
Advised clients on ad-spend budget planning and allocation across paid campaigns.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and delivered optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting, and translated performance data into recommendations for multi-stakeholder accounts.

Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Partnered with Product and Engineering, delivering structured, high-priority customer feedback that informed the roadmap.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows so they could communicate product value.

bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors; closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (~$130K+ total).

bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, advising C-suite clients at agencies and professional-services firms on operational system design.
